argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: reconstructive critique with internal and external refutation
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: moderate-high; premises are stated but often embedded in rhetorical prose

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: high; engages with strongest version of opponent and considers objections
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: high; all sections bear on the central thesis
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: mixed; some premises are plausible, others rely on contested semantic assumptions

explicit_definitions_given: proposition-function: an open formula or function that, when combined with context, yields a proposition
paratactic theory: treating 'Galileo said that' and 'the earth moves' as separate syntactic units
deliberate ambiguity: pragmatic exploitation of underspecification to convey multiple contents

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: considers objections from internal tension, deliberate ambiguity, and cross-linguistic syntax
objections_raised: Kemp reintroduces propositions, undermining Davidson's ontology
determinate proposition-functions cannot model deliberate ambiguity
demonstrative hypothesis violates standard syntactic theory
Hungarian data show complementizers and demonstratives are distinct

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: conceptual analysis, thought experiments, syntactic theory, cross-linguistic data

philosophical_orientation.grounding: analytic philosophy of language and semantics
philosophical_orientation.sentiment: critical of paratactic approach; favors complementation and intensional semantics
philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: ontology of propositions, syntax-semantics interface, pragmatic ambiguity

structural_organization.structure_type: five-section essay with introduction and conclusion; numbered sections and subsections

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay reconstructs Davidson's paratactic theory, presents Kemp's proposition-function modification, critiques it internally, tests it against deliberate ambiguity, and refutes the demonstrative hypothesis with Hungarian evidence, concluding that parataxis is a dead end.
